title: High-Dimensional Approximate Factor Models with Score-Driven Dynamics: Estimation and Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.20030v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a factor model for high-dimensional time series where the dynamics of the latent factors is generated by a multivariate score-driven model, thus allowing to model nonlinearities and heavy tails in both the conditional mean and the conditional variance. Estimation is in two steps: first the factors are extracted via Principal Components and then the parameters of the score-driven model are estimated via Quasi Maximum Likelihood based on the estimated factors. Since factors are not identified, we first establish set-consistency and asymptotic normality for the estimated parameters governing their dynamics, as both the number of time series and the sample size diverge to infinity. Then, we construct valid asymptotic prediction intervals, which do not depend on the chosen identifying constraints for the factors. Numerical results confirm the goodness of our estimator.

translated_title: 基于得分驱动动态的高维近似因子模型：估计与推断
translated_abstract: 我们为高维时间序列提出了一种因子模型，其中潜在因子的动态由多元得分驱动模型生成，从而能够对条件均值和条件方差中的非线性特征及厚尾现象进行建模。估计过程分为两步：首先通过主成分分析提取因子，然后基于估计出的因子，利用拟极大似然方法估计得分驱动模型的参数。由于因子本身不可识别，我们首先在时间序列数量与样本量均趋于无穷的条件下，为控制因子动态的估计参数建立了集一致性与渐近正态性。随后，我们构建了有效的渐近预测区间，该区间不依赖于所选的因子识别约束。数值结果证实了我们估计量的良好性能。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种潜在因子动态由多元得分驱动模型生成的高维近似因子模型，在因子不可识别的条件下建立了估计参数的集一致性与渐近正态性，并构造出不依赖识别约束的有效渐近预测区间。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a high-dimensional approximate factor model whose latent factor dynamics are generated by a multivariate score-driven model, establishing set-consistency and asymptotic normality for the estimated parameters under factor non-identification, and constructing valid asymptotic prediction intervals independent of identifying constraints.
